API basic information query

API for querying countries of origin, Shoplinker marketplaces, carriers, and product disclosure information.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/api_basic.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required type string Type Optional
  1. - Country of origin : 001
  2. - Shoplinker marketplace : 002
  3. - Carrier : 003
  4. - Product disclosure information : 004
  5. - Sales customer : 005
  6. - Certification code : 006
3. use_yn string Enabled Optional
  1. - List of marketplaces in use : Y
  2. - All marketplaces : N
 type : 002 is used for Shoplinker marketplaces
Default : Y

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<BasicInfo>
		<Info>
			<customer_id>a0000001</customer_id>
			<type>001</type>
		</Info>
	</BasicInfo>
</Shoplinker>

Response

For countries of origin, Shoplinker marketplaces, carriers, sales customers, or certification codes

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. code string Code
2. name string Name
3. use_yn string Enabled Optional
  1. - Enabled : Y
  2. - Disabled : N
 type : 002 is shown only for Shoplinker marketplaces.
4. user_id string Marketplace ID type : 002 is shown only for Shoplinker marketplaces.
5. scm_url string Marketplace URL type : 002 is shown only for Shoplinker marketplaces. 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<BasicInfo>
		<Info>
			<code><![CDATA[APIORIGIN_145]]></code>
			<name><![CDATA[BANGLADESH]]></name>
		</Info>
		<Info>
			<code><![CDATA[APIORIGIN_159]]></code>

		<Info>
